description: An ambient structure models the background theory if and only if every sort is nonempty and every original function preserves the individual sort.
signature:

  U ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.backgroundTheory L ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Admissible
